finding: CSS overflow-axis computation makes overflow-y:visible compute to auto when overflow-x is hidden. The attempted Addendum-02 split-axis policy therefore remained a scroll container and did not restore unclipped vertical carrier visibility. This is a carrier-policy defect common to every family, not a color result.

correction.horizontal_requirement: Do not mask horizontal overflow. Measure frame.scrollWidth against the frozen 320 CSS px frame and fail if it exceeds 320 CSS px.
correction.vertical_requirement: Panel/action/focus geometry may extend below the frozen 720 CSS px reference-frame box only if overflow is visibly rendered rather than clipped; the specimen remains a single 320 CSS px column with no content reorder.
correction.unchanged: Frame height 720, panel top 72, panel width 288, all padding/type/spacing/radii/content, all family/control colors and role allocation remain unchanged.

guardrail: This mechanical correction cannot be used to conceal real horizontal overflow or to change any candidate family after result exposure.
